# Home Automation Cookbook

> Practical, platform-neutral home automation recipes that reduce repeated checks and adjustments while preserving familiar household controls.

Home Automation Cookbook explains reusable automation patterns in plain English. Recipes cover triggers, conditions, actions, manual overrides, failure behavior, and acceptance checks. Product recommendations are limited to devices I have personally used.

## Start here

- [Home Automation Cookbook](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/): An introduction to the site's family-first approach.
- [Automation recipes](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/): Search and browse the complete recipe directory.
- [Getting started](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/getting-started/): Learn how to plan a first automation.
- [Philosophy](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/getting-started/philosophy.html): Principles for useful, reversible, and dependable automation.
- [Tips and tricks](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/getting-started/tips.html): Practical guidance for building and testing automations.
- [Choose devices and gear](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/getting-started/device-guide.html): Personally used products and device-selection guidance.

## Recipe categories

- [Lighting](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/lighting/): Motion, doors, nighttime, outdoor lighting, and wake-up routines.
- [Daily routines](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/daily-routines/): Morning, bedtime, guest, arrival, and away behavior.
- [Climate and comfort](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/climate/): HVAC, fans, blinds, air quality, windows, and temperature monitoring.
- [Entertainment](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/entertainment/): Music, television lighting, volume, arrivals, and gatherings.
- [Appliances](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/appliances/): Laundry, refrigerator doors, coffee preparation, and robot vacuums.
- [Safety and security](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/security/): Alert-first leak, fire, garage, stove, and away recipes.
- [Notifications and alerts](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/automation/notifications/): Batteries, status, chores, doorbells, pets, and maintenance.

- [Platform guidance](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/platforms/): Firsthand platform experience and technical-fit comparisons.
- [Articles](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/articles/): Longer-form home automation lessons and observations.
- [FAQ](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/faq/): Answers to common questions.
